items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: I said, "C'mon, Johnny, let's get something together."

ctx.x: We was playing the Pearl Theater in Baltimore -- not in -- yeah, Baltimore, and these two comedians, they had a little thing about the numbers. They didn't have no music but they used to just stand up there, the two by themselves, and say, "We -- I got the number." "Where did you get it from?" Just them two. And so I started out, I said, "C'mon, Johnny, let's get something together." So I started out (humming), and Johnny fell in. A little later on Braud started in. Then after Braud started in, then Harry Carney…
Do you remember who the comedians were?
